title: Sampling from scratch

wrong.exp_log_u.py: inverse CDF uses -log(u)/rate, which maps u=0 to infinity and is a reflected, not the same, stream of draws
wrong.exp_forgets_rate.py: inverse CDF ignores the rate, so every rate gives the mean-1 distribution
wrong.categorical_side_left.py: searchsorted side='left' sends a uniform that lands exactly on a boundary to the wrong category
wrong.categorical_unclipped.py: does not guard the tail: float error in the last cumulative sum can index past the last category
wrong.rejection_no_envelope.py: accepts when u <= f(x) instead of u*M <= f(x): the envelope M is ignored and the distribution is distorted
wrong.box_muller_missing_two.py: radius is sqrt(-log(u1)) instead of sqrt(-2*log(u1)): variance is 1/2
wrong.box_muller_cos_twice.py: returns cos for both outputs, so the two normals are perfectly correlated

hints: Inverse transform: if F is the CDF and U is uniform on [0,1), then F^-1(U) has CDF F. For the exponential, F(x) = 1 - exp(-rate*x); solve for x.

Categorical: build the cumulative sum of the probabilities and find, for each u, the first bucket whose cumulative value is strictly greater than u. np.searchsorted with side='right' does it in one call. Clip the result to len(probs)-1.
Rejection: keep proposal x when u * M <= f(x), where M >= max f is the envelope height over a uniform proposal. Box-Muller: r = sqrt(-2 ln u1), angle = 2*pi*u2, outputs r*cos and r*sin.
